Vinpearl Empire Nha Trang – Five-Star Luxury at the Heart of the Coastal City
Boasting a prime location, the hotel stands out with its sleek, contemporary architecture and elegant design, opening up expansive views of both the sea and the city skyline. Featuring a collection of sophisticated, well-appointed guest rooms alongside a diverse range of premium amenities, including a swimming pool, restaurants, bars, and state-of-the-art meeting and event spaces, the hotel is an ideal destination to experience the seamless harmony between Nha Trang’s natural beauty and its dynamic urban rhythm.
One-bedroom Suite​
Ideal for families, this spacious one-bedroom suite will become your home in the city of Nha Trang. Furnished with carefully selected facilities, a wooden floor and a large balcony, this stylish accommodation is the epitome of exclusivity.​

Vinpearl Empire Nha Trang – Sophisticated Dining in a Premium Ambience
Savor a refined spectrum of flavors, from authentic Vietnamese to international cuisine — from the generous buffet offerings at Amber, to thoughtfully curated culinary highlights at Garnet, and relaxed moments enjoying signature cocktails by the Pool Bar.
Amber Restaurant
6:00 - 10:30
Perched on the 5th floor, the restaurant showcases refined Vietnamese and international gastronomy, curated by our team of accomplished chefs.
Garnet Restaurant
11:00 - 22:00
Set on the 5th floor, the restaurant delivers an elevated Vietnamese and international dining experience, curated by our accomplished culinary team.
Pool Bar
9:00 - 18:00
Unwind by the pool with sweeping panoramic views of the city, an ideal setting to relax and recharge or enjoy moments with friends. The poolside bar offers a curated selection of signature cocktails, premium beers, and fine wines.
